notes:
**New**
- **Your subscriptions count in Refract**: sign in on twitch.tv once (Settings → Streams → Your subscriptions) and channels you're subbed to play the real stream with no ads and no extra delay. With Turbo, nothing has ads. You can also sign in on kick.com there. YouTube streams already play without YouTube's ads, Premium or not.
- **Ambient mode lights up the whole app**: the colors of the stream you're listening to glow softly across the top bar, sidebar, chat and every page, not just around the video.
- **One followed list for every site**: Twitch, Kick and YouTube channels are listed together, biggest streams first. The ring around each picture shows the site: purple for Twitch, green for Kick, red for YouTube. Add Kick or YouTube channels with the **+** at the top of the list.
- **What's new**: after Refract updates, the first launch shows what changed (you're reading it).

**Fixed**
- **Chat**: a proper column layout. Timestamps sit in their own column and messages wrap under the message, not under the time. Names never get split from their colon, rows of emotes no longer overlap, very long words wrap instead of jumping to a new line, and highlighted or sub messages line up with everything else. Chat also stays at the bottom when emotes finish loading.
